description: For mode "authorization" only. Pass every field of `purchase` from geode_upgrade_prepare unchanged, plus your EIP-712 signature. The server simulates the purchase for free (a bad signature never costs you gas) and returns one unsigned transaction for you to send from the same wallet.

buyer.description: Your Base (EVM) address, 0x…: the wallet that holds the USDC, signs, sends the transactions and pays the gas.

geode_address.description: The Geode account (SS58) that receives the GEODE. Double-check it: a purchase delivered to a wrong address cannot be reversed.

signature.description: Your EIP-712 signature of typed_data, 0x-prefixed hex

name: geode_upgrade_build
title: Build a one-transaction upgrade purchase
